about: John Tenniel's engravings for Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (1865) and Through the Looking-Glass (1871). Public domain; Tenniel died in 1914. Scanned by Standard Ebooks, whose own work on them is dedicated to the public domain. Never add Disney's designs or any later adaptation (DECISIONS.md, D-009). The renderer downloads each picture from the commit pinned here, so a picture can never change under us.
